messages:
emma-sales: Hi team — running into a compliance gate on the AcuHealth POC. They want single-tenant isolation (VPC + dedicated instances), ISO27001 artifact set, and an explicit pen-test letter before greenlight. Also asking how this affects pricing.

sam-security: @emma-sales for ISO we can share the certificate PDF + scope and the control narrative. For pen-test we provide a signed attestation letter; we don't share full reports unless redacted and requested by legal. :lock:

liam-ops: Single-tenant means Dedicated or Private. Dedicated pricing uplift is usually +25-40% depending on commit. If they need on-prem or air-gapped, that's enterprise + one-time deployment.

emma-sales: timeline? they want proofs within 5 business days to start their procurement cycle. Can we meet that?

maria-se: We can assemble a POC package: certs, SOC/ISO excerpts, pen-test attestation template, staging KMS workflow. I'll prepare a link to the dropbox.

alex-legal: FYI — if they request the full pen-test report we need an NDA + scoping call. For the attestation letter I can sign the standard template. If they want specific redactions note those up front.

sam-security: Drafting attestation now. Sample wording: 
```
Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test covering external network and application layers was completed on 2025-11-03 and findings were remediated as of 2025-12-10. Full report is confidential and may be shared under NDA.
```
Will drop signed PDF when Alex signs.

liam-ops: For Dedicated POC we need an ops ticket to provision env and toggle isolation flags. Est time: 3 business days once legal & billing approve. Also need a short list of expected peak QPS and max seq length for cost sizing.

emma-sales: They're expecting ~50 requests/sec peak, most sequences <512 tokens. Budget sensitivity — they asked for an estimate of monthly committed cost for Dedicated vs Hosted with IP protections.

maria-se: Quick estimate: Hosted w/ additional legal controls ~ $Xk/mo, Dedicated (medium pool) ~ $1.35Xk/mo + onboarding. I'll make a clean comparison table.

alex-legal: I'll review the attestation and sign by EOD if no surprises. Also confirm whether they need SOC 2 Type II or just ISO excerpts (some EU health customers ask for both).

emma-sales: They specifically called out ISO27001 certificate + ISMS scope doc, but procurement may ask SOC 2 sample logs later. Let's include both to be safe.

maria-se: Uploading initial bundle to shared drive: https://redwood.company/share/acuh-health-poc (link expires in 7 days) — includes: ISO certificate, ISMS scope, control narrative excerpt, pen-test attestation template, Dedicated pricing sheet, provisioning checklist.

deploy-bot: Ticket opened: OPS-5421 (Provision Dedicated POC) — assignee: @liam-ops — ETA 3 business days.

liam-ops: Confirmed, I'll request the QPS/seq details in OPS ticket and queue firewall/VPC config.

emma-sales: Thanks team. Action items: @sam-security finalize signed attestation, @alex-legal sign, @maria-se finalize bundle & pricing table, @liam-ops start ops ticket. I'll follow up with procurement on NDA if they ask for full report. :thumbsup:
